name: Clean Lecture
tagline: White canvas with flat hand-drawn style SVG diagrams, bold black headings and blue, purple, green and amber accents.

palette.description: White with ink text and five flat accent colours for diagrams.

typography.style: Heavy sans titles and regular sans labels; replaces the original Chinese font.

best_for: Teaching-style decks built around timelines, before and after scenes, flow chains and bar comparisons. Works when one picture per slide carries the idea.
avoid_for: Dense text reports or brand-heavy marketing decks.
navigation: inline keyboard handler (ArrowRight/Space, click, touch); step reveals are shown on slide entry
